scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w extension
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w server && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p extension/tsconfig.json
